subject: Recap: budget alignment & token thresholds — next steps
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Elliot Harper <elliot@clearpathhealth.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Recap: budget alignment & token thresholds — next steps

Hi Elliot / Maria — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick written recap so we have alignment and clear next steps for procurement.

Call summary (high level):
- Use case: realtime triage + clinical note augmentation; mix of short prompts (50–200 tokens) and medium context (up to 2k tokens) when pulling patient history.
- Expected steady-state traffic: 15–25M tokens/month (initial), potential to spike to ~60M tokens/month if the pilot expands to two more clinics.
- Accuracy/QoS: 95th percentile latency target ~350ms for single-turn prompts; will accept quantized model variant if cost reductions are material.

Cost signals you shared:
- Procurement budget range: $8k–$30k/mo depending on committed volumes and term.
- Target unit economics: ideally <$400 per 1M tokens for production workload; willing to consider higher for premium latency SLA.

Attached: ClearPath_cost_model_v1.xlsx — simple scenario sheet I walked through on the call (Conservative / Base / Upside).

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll send a formal two-scenario estimate (hosted on-demand vs reserved/dedicated) with line items and a one-page invoice-preview. (Deliverable: Estimate PDF + cost calc) — by EOD today.
2) You confirm legal/PO contact and any special procurement fields we should include on the invoice.
3) If numbers look good, we propose a 30-minute billing walk-through next week to lock the SKU and commitment term.

Notes for internal: Rishi / Priyom — I flagged the spreadsheet with the token mix assumptions (sheet: token_mix). We'll likely need to show both a quantized LLM variant and the standard baseline; list out the monthly cost delta.

Thanks — V.

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Vanessa — thanks for the quick recap, that aligns with how we heard it too. A couple clarifying asks before we review the estimate: 

- Can you provide two delivered scenarios: (A) conservative pilot (15M tokens/mo) and (B) scale pilot (50–60M tokens/mo), each with a per-1M-token line and a monthly total?
- For each scenario please show: model variant (baseline vs quantized), expected latency tier, and the effective $/1M tokens after any commitment discount.
- Procurement note: purchase order will need the invoice to include Redwoods’ standard legal name and our corporate billing address — I’ll send PO contact details after I confirm with finance.

If you can get the two-scenario PDF in my inbox today that would be great; we’re trying to get procurement lined up for early January.

Appreciate it — Elliot

Subject: Estimate: ClearPath — hosted vs reserved scenarios (attached)

Elliot / Maria — attached is the one-page estimate and the updated pricing calc per our discussion. Quick summary below. Attached files: Estimate_ClearPath_20261218.pdf (one-pager), pricing_calc_v2.xlsx (detailed calc).

Scenario A — Pilot (15M tokens/month) — Hosted (on-demand):
- Model: Redwood-standard (FP16)
- Base monthly platform fee: $0 (self-serve hosted)
- Token rate: $420 per 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly token cost: 15 * $420 = $6,300
- Expected monthly invoice: $6,300 (+ taxes)

Scenario B — Scale pilot (50M tokens/month) — Dedicated reserved pool (12-mo commit):
- Model: quantized-optimized variant (same quality band)
- Reserved capacity monthly fee: $3,000
- Token rate (committed tier): $300 per 1M tokens
- Estimated monthly token cost: 50 * $300 = $15,000
- Total monthly (incl. reserved fee): $18,000
- Effective $/1M tokens = $360 (including reserved fee amortized across tokens at 50M)

Commit discount note: We can extend an additional 10–15% off token rate for 12-mo + 100% usage commitment (finalized by legal). I called this out as a conditional concession in the estimate.

Next steps (same as call):
- Please confirm PO/billing contact and whether we should include any SOW references on the invoice.
- If the dedicated scenario looks promising, Rishi / I can lock the reserved capacity SKU and prepare a DocuSign for a 12-month commitment.

Vanessa

Vanessa / Rishi — quick internal note after reviewing the calc:
- The pricing_calc_v2.xlsx already includes a token-mix sheet; the 50M scenario assumes 70% short-turn prompts which makes the quantized variant viable.
- Recommend we present a formal commitment concession at 12% off the committed token rate (which nets to ~$264 per 1M tokens in the 50M scenario) instead of the more aggressive 15% unless Finance signs off. That keeps our gross margin aligned with Dedicated targets.
- I also added a billing line for a one-time onboarding fee ($1,200) in the calc — call that out if procurement asks.

If you want, I can prepare an updated PDF that shows the 12% concession and the onboarding fee; ping me and I’ll drop it into the DocuSign packet.
